name: Concordia Venus

categories.label: Vesta cards
categories.hint: Goods in storehouse at printed price + cash; 1 VP per full 10 sestertii, per Vesta card.

categories.label: Jupiter cards
categories.hint: 1 VP per house in a non-brick city, max 15 per card. Legatus counts as Jupiter too.

categories.label: Saturnus cards
categories.hint: 1 VP per province with at least one of your houses, per card. Legatus counts as Saturnus too.

categories.label: Venus cards
categories.hint: Individual: 2 VP per province with 2+ of your houses, max 14 per card. Legatus counts as Venus too.

categories.label: Mercurius cards
categories.hint: 2 VP per type of goods your houses produce, max 10 per card.

categories.label: Mars cards
categories.hint: 2 VP per colonist of yours on the board, max 12 per card.

categories.label: Minerva specialist cards
categories.hint: Per specialist: houses in matching city type x VP printed on that card. Enter each card total.

categories.label: Concordia card
categories.hint: +7 VP for the player who triggered game end.

tiebreakers.description: Player/team holding the Praefectus Magnus wins; otherwise the tied player who would receive it next
tiebreakers.descriptionVi: Người (đội) giữ Praefectus Magnus thắng; nếu không thì người hòa sẽ nhận nó tiếp theo.

notes: family: auction-money (card-purchase end-game god scoring). Game ends when the last display card is bought or a player builds their 15th house; the trigger player takes the Concordia card, all others play one last turn. Each card scored per its god; Legatus counts once each for Jupiter, Saturnus and Venus. Team play variant: Venus = 1 VP per province where both partners each have a house (max = number of provinces); team VP = sum of both partners; not modelled. Optional intermediate scoring (first Tribune play) gives sestertii not VP; not modelled. Caps are enforced via min() in expr.

sources.title: How to play Concordia Venus (Ultra BoardGames)

winConditionVi: Điểm cao nhất thắng. Hòa thì người giữ Praefectus Magnus thắng; nếu không, người sẽ nhận nó tiếp theo.
